fields.description:
Implement the Nearest Neighbor algorithm for TSP with GPU acceleration support using CuPy and proper protocol-based architecture.

*Academic Context*: TCC research implementation
*Learning Objective*: Master greedy algorithms and GPU memory patterns
*Expected Outcome*: 5x+ speedup for problems with n>1000 cities

*Technical Requirements*:
- Protocol-based DistanceProvider interface
- Support for NumPy, Numba, and CuPy backends
- Comprehensive testing and benchmarking
- Academic documentation with complexity analysis
fields.customfield_10002: Master greedy algorithm design and GPU memory patterns
